mapper.update: UPDATE fnd30_opr SET fnd30_demand_date = #{r.demandDate}, fnd30_item_nm = #{r.itemName}, fnd30_lead_manager = #{r.leadManager}, fnd30_demand_period = #{r.demandPeriod}, fnd30_market = #{r.market}, fnd30_price_bracket = #{r.priceBracket}, fnd30_price = #{r.price}, fnd30_price_accept_yn = CASE WHEN #{r.priceAcceptYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, fnd30_lock_period = #{r.lockPeriod}, fnd30_note = #{r.note}, fnd30_cancel_yn = CASE WHEN #{r.cancelYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END WHERE fnd30_opr_id = #{oprId} AND fnd30_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.sql: fnd30_opr_id AS opr_id, fnd30_opr_cd AS opr_code, fnd30_subscription_date AS subscription_date, fnd30_item_nm AS item_name, fnd30_corp_id AS corp_id, f_get_corp_nm(fnd30_corp_id) AS corp_name, fnd30_price AS price, fnd30_fee_rate AS fee_rate, fnd30_pay_date AS pay_date, fnd30_qty AS qty, fnd30_lock_period AS lock_period, fnd30_appr_id AS appr_id, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, fnd30_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name, fnd30_note AS note, fnd30_demand_id AS demand_id
mapper.select: SELECT fnd30_opr_id AS opr_id , fnd30_demand_date AS demand_date , fnd30_item_nm AS item_name , fnd30_market AS market , fnd30_lead_manager AS lead_manager , fnd30_price AS price , fnd30_lock_period AS lock_period , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , sch10_pay_date AS sch_pay_date , fnd30_note AS note FROM fnd30_opr LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON fnd30_appr_id = apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch10_ipo ON sch10_item_nm = fnd30_item_nm WHERE 1=1 AND (sch10_cancel_yn = 'false' OR sch10_cancel_yn IS NULL) AND fnd30_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd30_opr_cd = #{oprCode} AND fnd30_demand_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' AND COALESCE(fnd30_cancel_yn,'false') != 'true' AND fnd30_opr_id NOT IN (SELECT fnd30_demand_id FROM fnd30_opr WHERE fnd30_opr_cd = '01' AND fnd30_demand_id IS NOT NULL) AND UPPER((fnd30_item_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY fnd30_subscription_date DESC , fnd30_item_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd30_opr ( fnd30_opr_id, fnd30_company_id, fnd30_opr_cd, fnd30_opr_date, fnd30_subscription_date, fnd30_pay_date, fnd30_item_nm , fnd30_corp_id, fnd30_price, fnd30_fee_rate, fnd30_qty, fnd30_lock_period, fnd30_note, fnd30_demand_id ) VALUES ( #{oprId}, #{companyId}, '01', #{r.subscriptionDate}, #{r.subscriptionDate}, #{r.payDate}, #{r.itemName} , #{r.corpId}, #{r.price}, #{r.feeRate}, #{r.qty}, #{r.lockPeriod}, #{r.note}, #{r.demandId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd30_opr SET fnd30_subscription_date = #{r.subscriptionDate}, fnd30_pay_date = #{r.payDate}, fnd30_item_nm = #{r.itemName}, fnd30_corp_id = #{r.corpId}, fnd30_price = #{r.price}, fnd30_fee_rate = #{r.feeRate}, fnd30_qty = #{r.qty}, fnd30_lock_period = #{r.lockPeriod}, fnd30_note = #{r.note} WHERE fnd30_opr_id = #{oprId} AND fnd30_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd30_opr_cd = '01'
